 Soule’s market value rises to €50 million
 Andy Mattioli
 8 seconds ago 
 (Photo by Giuseppe Maffia/NurPhoto via Getty Images) 
 Matias Soulé is increasingly becoming a key player for Gian Piero Gasperini’s Roma, contributing goals and assists. 
 The Argentine striker appears to be on the path to becoming a star player for the Giallorossi, thus dispelling any doubts that lingered over him this summer, especially after the groin strain that hampered him in the second half of last season. 
 As reported by Corriere dello Sport , the 2003-born striker scored 15 goals and provided 16 assists for the club, a contribution that brought him a remarkable 26 points. 
 This impressive tally demonstrates the importance of the former Frosinone player’s play.
 Soulé is increasing his market value. The Argentine striker, aside from his goals, is maturing in his decisions on the pitch, a fact Gasperini has also emphasized in recent weeks. 
 Compared to last season, his dribbling and shots on goal have increased, important stats for a winger. 
 The number 18 is now worth €50 million, a figure that underscores his growth from a talent to be launched into a key figure in Roma’s present and future.
